Method of Attack: Backdoor malware pretending to be COVID-19 information
Uses Cloudflare Workers as an interface to the malware's command and control (C2) server
Malware distributed via phishing emails with a RAR file named 'Important - COVID-19.rar'
Malicious executable disguised as a Word document 'Important - COVID-19.docx.exe'
Extracts and opens a decoy COVID-19 Word document while installing malware
Extracts and runs 'sqltuner.exe' which connects to a Cloudflare Worker C2
Uses JSON encoded commands from ReactJS Strapi App backend
Employs Cloudflare Workers to hide actual C2 and evade IP blocking
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by use of .exe and %UserProfile% paths)
Attack Vector: Phishing emails distributing malicious RAR archive
Indicators of Compromise: Executable file 'Important - COVID-19.docx.exe' disguised with Word icon
Extracted file 'Important - COVID-19.docx.docx' opened as decoy document
